_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Bookings roadmap rendered at /docs/extensions/bookings/roadmap. Task status is maintained by `npm run roadmap:bookings` (scripts/gen-roadmap.mjs) from the extension source tree.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Bookables and the booking form
milestones.goal: Anything bookable, one availability engine, and a booking form that is a normal form.

tasks.title: Bookables by the night or by time slot
tasks.detail: Rooms, rentals, tables and services: how many at once, guest limit, seasonal nightly rates, fees and deposit, or opening hours cut into slots with a break, minimum notice and how far ahead.

tasks.title: One availability engine
tasks.detail: What is free and what it costs, asked by the calendar, the server check, the REST endpoint and the admin alike; held pending bookings, blocks and other calendars all count.

tasks.title: Dates and availability field + Reserve action
tasks.detail: A live calendar in any form (taken dates struck through, free times, the price), booked under a lock when the form is sent; answer tags and two starters.

tasks.title: Confirm or decline, from the email or the admin
tasks.detail: The owner alert with signed Confirm / Decline links, the guest receipt and answer emails, and the Bookings list with blocks.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Running the bookings
milestones.goal: Everything an owner needs day to day.

tasks.title: Calendar view in the admin
tasks.detail: A month and week view of every bookable, with drag to block and click to open a booking; add a phone booking by hand.

tasks.title: Sync with other booking sites
tasks.detail: Import other channels' calendars (hourly) and export ours at a secret address, per bookable, so a night booked elsewhere is never offered here.

tasks.title: Guests manage their booking
tasks.detail: A private link in every email to see, change or cancel the booking within the rules the owner sets.

tasks.title: Deposits and totals paid online
tasks.detail: The booking's total or deposit added to the Forms order, so Stripe or PayPal take it when the form is sent; refunds noted on the booking.

tasks.title: CRM connection
tasks.detail: Guests become contacts with each booking on their timeline and a pipeline of stays.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · More ways to book
milestones.goal: The cases a single rental or a single service does not cover.

tasks.title: The visitor chooses what to book
tasks.detail: One field offering several rooms or staff, with what is free for the chosen dates.

tasks.title: Weekday rates, long-stay discounts, extras
tasks.detail: Weekend prices, a discount from a number of nights, and priced extras (breakfast, airport pickup).

tasks.title: Reminders and follow-ups
tasks.detail: An email before arrival or the appointment, and a thank-you after.

tasks.title: Import and export, and moving a rental site's own booking plugin onto Bookings
tasks.detail: Bookings → Import / Export: export bookings as a CSV (the columns the import reads) or as a Bookings file (every bookable's settings and its bookings), and import from a CSV, a Bookings file, or any source a site registers (fw_ext_bookings_import_sources). The bespoke plugin that pioneered the Stay dates field and Reserve action gets its own site-specific source, kept on that site.
